summary.text: Mary Bradfield, a Republican, represents District 21 (El Paso County) in the Colorado House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: She has held the seat since January 2021, succeeding Lois Landgraf.
She was born in Iowa, lives in Colorado Springs, and earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University.
Her career experience includes working as an education specialist.
